name: initializeMolecule
shortDescription: Creates a new Molecule record along with its four predefined, immutable Quadrant entities.
description:
Overview

Creates a new Molecule record and automatically provisions its four fixed Quadrants (Logistics, Operations, External Functions, Internal Objectives).

Intended use

Called by the Lead Point persona from a UI to set up a new project or event. Parameters include name and description for the Molecule.

Logic

  1. Create a new Molecule record using ctx.data.create with name, description, and leadPointId (from ctx.user_id).
  2. For each of the four fixed quadrant names ("Logistics", "Operations", "External Functions", "Internal Objectives"):
    1. Create a new Quadrant record using ctx.data.create with moleculeId (from the newly created Molecule), the quadrant name, a default description, and an order value.
  3. Audit-log the Molecule creation and quadrant initialization using ctx.audit.log, including the new Molecule's ID.
  4. Return the created Molecule record along with its Quadrants.

Entities

  • Molecule
  • Quadrant
